comments.body: I wonder if there also should be either a parameter on InstantSearch or a widget-like interface for Vue InstantSearch etc.

I think all framework-based flavors (Vue InstantSearch, React InstantSearch, Angular InstantSearch) will have their dedicated APIs but this flexible top-level InstantSearch.js should enable all those to use middleware.
I renamed the method to hook middleware `EXPERIMENTAL_use`. This is meant to discourage users to use it for now and to postpone its documentation.

title: feat(router): plug router as a middleware
